name: pideck
description: A calm, editorial desktop workspace for Pi.

scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @pideck/contracts run typecheck && npm --workspace @pideck/domain run typecheck && npm --workspace @pideck/pi-adapter run typecheck && npm --workspace @pideck/permission-engine run typecheck && npm --workspace @pideck/pi-host run typecheck && npm --workspace @pideck/i18n run typecheck && npm --workspace @pideck/ui-system run typecheck && npm --workspace @pideck/desktop run typecheck
scripts.package:win:x64: npm run notices:check && npm run build && npm exec -- electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 && npm run verify:package -- release/win-unpacked && npm run smoke:package -- release/win-unpacked
scripts.package:mac: npm run notices:check && npm run build && npm exec -- electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg && npm run verify:package -- release && npm run smoke:package -- release
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run notices:check && npm run build && npm exec -- electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg --arm64 && npm run verify:package -- release && npm run smoke:package -- release
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run notices:check && npm run build && npm exec -- electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg --x64 && npm run verify:package -- release && npm run smoke:package -- release
